gen-dafont-groovy-gf-anek-gujarati: Groovy is friendly and funky, its c almost sealed to a narrow slit and every stroke drawn without any pressure swell. Anek Gujarati opens that c wide and lets its lowercase rival the capitals.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi reads clean and professional, with big open counters in every small letter and generous, open-handed curves. Under Groovy's thick outlines, whole paragraphs would glide along without snagging.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-anek-kannada: Friendly, Groovy pinches its c nearly shut, while its joins carry full weight. Anek Kannada counters with a high x-height like squared woodblock letters and terminals that stop far from the stem.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin keeps its lowercase tall, nearly touching the capitals, and holds its curves apart rather than curling them shut. Groovy bends cable-like lines into shapes, while Anek Latin does the quiet talking.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-anek-malayalam: Groovy pinches its c to a narrow slit and tracks its lowercase loosely. Anek Malayalam keeps caps close to its lowercase and leaves curve tips open, so paragraphs would flow smoothly.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-anek-odia: Groovy is friendly and funky, with a c nearly pinched shut. Anek Odia leaves its rounds unlatched like an open hook and keeps capitals barely above lowercase, so text would move along easily.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-anek-tamil: Friendly Groovy nearly seals its c into a slit. Anek Tamil brings big round lowercase bowls and half-unwrapped curves, so a stretch of text would read modern and smooth.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-anek-telugu: Friendly Groovy draws everything with zero stroke contrast and a nearly closed c. And Anek Telugu sets wide, tall bowls and unlatched rounds rolling through paragraphs with an easy rhythm.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-anuphan: Anuphan reads with big round lowercase bowls and open curves that keep clear gaps between their ends. Groovy does the loud, monoline closing-up; Anuphan does the opening out.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-arimo: Friendly Groovy pinches its c nearly shut and spaces its lowercase loosely, with arms and legs of constant width. Arimo's tall mean line and generous terminal gaps would keep paragraphs moving.
